correctness.rationale: For n positive and 3 not dividing n, writing z=2^n and epsilon=(-1)^n yields exact cubic factors C,E,F. The modular-19 order-three argument proves 57 divides E, while C,F are divisible by 3; T_n=(C/3)(E/57) and T_{3n}=(F/3)(E/57). As z^3 is epsilon modulo C, F is 3 modulo C; hence gcd(C,F)=3 and the reduced factors are coprime. The boundary n=1 vs n>=2 is established by an elementary inequality. An exact finite verifier checks 267 admissible indices but is not relied upon for the universal claim.

No checked primary theorem, sequence record or nearby published finding states the present exact coprime factorization and its missing factor. General Lucas valuation theorems could yield alternative derivations but do not directly state this structural boundary; unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
